args: In rdkit/Code/GraphMol/RWMol.cpp, what is the most idiomatic way for RWMol::replaceAtom() to redirect Atom* entries in d_stereo_groups from the old atom to its replacement while preserving StereoGroup type, read ID, and write ID? Please identify any existing helper or mutator, and relevant constructor invariants from rdkit/Code/GraphMol/StereoGroup.h/.cpp.

The sanitizer report shows a heap-use-after-free because RWMol::replaceAtom() deletes d_graph[vd] but only updates atom bookmarks; enhanced StereoGroup objects retain raw pointers to the deleted Atom. I have inspected replaceAtom at lines 131-156 and StereoGroup.h: getAtoms() returns a const vector, while metadata consists of group type, read ID, and write ID. My likely patch is to reconstruct each affected StereoGroup with a copied atom vector in which orig_p is replaced by atom_p, pass the original read ID to the constructor, restore write ID using setWriteId(), and assign it back before deleting orig_p. I want to confirm whether a helper/mutator already exists and whether this preserves all invariants.
